results.name: a completely unrelated victim (not the actual request's victim) can no longer read this delivery
results.note: FIXED (previously a real finding): the rule used to be `userRole() in ["admin","victim"]`, a role check not an ownership check, letting ANY authenticated victim account read ANY delivery document. Replaced with isOwningVictim() — confirmed here that an unrelated victim is now correctly denied.
